title: Lula Wins Historic Second Term in Brazil
subtitle: How a powerful comeback changed the future of the country

summary.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has secured a historic second term in office. After trailing in the first round of voting, he successfully defeated his opponent, Flávio Bolsonaro. This victory is the first time in Brazil's democratic history that a candidate has come back from a first-round loss. The campaign success was driven by young voters and a strong social media strategy. Supporters and analysts believe this win represents a clear rejection of the political project led by the Bolsonaro family.
summary.zh: 巴西總統魯拉已贏得歷史性的第二任期。在首輪投票落後的情況下，他成功擊敗對手弗拉維奧·波索納洛。這是巴西民主史上首度有候選人在首輪落敗後逆轉勝出。這場競選的成功歸功於年輕選民與強大的社群媒體策略。支持者與分析家認為，此勝選代表大眾明確拒絕了波索納洛家族所主導的政治計畫。

paragraphs.en: President Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva has officially secured a historic second term as the leader of Brazil. Following a closely watched runoff election, the incumbent president defeated his opponent, senator Flávio Bolsonaro. This result is particularly significant because it marks the first time in the country’s democratic history that a candidate who finished second in the first round has managed to win the final vote. The victory follows a period of intense political competition that captured the attention of the entire nation.
paragraphs.zh: 巴西總統魯拉 (Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva) 已正式贏得歷史性的第二任期。在一場備受矚目的決選後，這位現任總統擊敗了對手、參議員弗拉維奧·波索納洛 (Flávio Bolsonaro)。此結果意義重大，因為這是該國民主史上，首度有在首輪投票中排名第二的候選人，最終成功逆轉勝出。這場勝利發生在一段競爭極度激烈的政治角力之後，吸引了全國民眾的目光。

paragraphs.en: According to The Guardian, the mood among Lula’s supporters was very different just three weeks ago. After the first round of voting, the president reportedly told his allies that he was surprised by the results, as he believed his government had performed well. Many analysts at the time expected Flávio Bolsonaro to win, especially because millions of voters from other right-wing candidates were likely to support him. The situation felt difficult for the left, and a sense of defeat began to spread among his supporters.
paragraphs.zh: 根據《衛報》(The Guardian) 報導，魯拉的支持者在短短三週前的心情截然不同。據悉，在首輪投票結束後，總統曾向盟友表示對結果感到驚訝，因為他認為自己的政府表現良好。當時許多分析家預期弗拉維奧·波索納洛會勝出，特別是因為其他右翼候選人的數百萬選民很可能會轉而支持他。當時對左派而言局勢艱困，支持者之間開始蔓延一股挫敗感。

paragraphs.en: However, the situation changed quickly due to the actions of young people across the country. The Guardian reports that students from the Fluminense Federal University began protesting in the streets of Niterói shortly after the first round. These demonstrations were a response to the potential return to power of the Bolsonaro family. The patriarch, former president Jair Bolsonaro, is currently under house arrest for attempting a coup—an illegal attempt to take control of the government by force. These protests soon spread to other cities, including Rio de Janeiro, creating a wave of energy that helped restart Lula’s campaign.
paragraphs.zh: 然而，由於全國各地年輕人的行動，局勢迅速改觀。《衛報》報導指出，弗魯米嫩塞聯邦大學 (Fluminense Federal University) 的學生在首輪投票後不久，便開始在尼泰羅伊 (Niterói) 的街頭進行抗議。這些示威活動是為了回應波索納洛家族可能重掌權力的危機。其家族大家長、前總統雅伊爾·波索納洛 (Jair Bolsonaro) 目前因企圖發動政變——即以武力非法奪取政府控制權——而遭到居家軟禁。這些抗議活動很快蔓延至里約熱內盧等其他城市，創造出一股能量，協助魯拉的競選活動重新啟動。

paragraphs.en: Beyond the streets, the campaign’s use of social media played a massive role in this comeback. Political scientist Fábio Vasconcellos noted that the victory was a result of the streets, social media, and the government’s own actions. In the final weeks, Lula introduced a package of benefits, which included increasing and speeding up payments from the main cash-transfer program designed to help poor families. This move was carefully planned to stay within the limits of electoral law.
paragraphs.zh: 除了街頭運動外，競選團隊對社群媒體的運用在這次逆轉中扮演了關鍵角色。政治學家法比奧·瓦斯康塞洛斯 (Fábio Vasconcellos) 指出，這場勝利是街頭運動、社群媒體以及政府自身作為共同作用的結果。在最後幾週，魯拉推出了一套福利方案，包括增加並加速發放旨在協助貧困家庭的主要現金轉移計畫款項。此舉經過審慎規劃，以確保符合選舉法的規範。

paragraphs.en: Digital strategy was another key factor. Congressman André Janones, a close ally of the president, created a WhatsApp channel called “Lula’s Army.” This channel provided daily instructions, videos, and messages to help supporters share pro-Lula content online. According to The Guardian, the channel grew from 60,000 followers on its first day to over 10 million by the time of the election. Lula even called Janones his “general” during his victory speech, praising his efforts to keep the morale of his supporters high throughout the campaign.
paragraphs.zh: 數位策略是另一個關鍵因素。身為總統親密盟友的國會議員安德烈·雅諾內斯 (André Janones) 建立了一個名為「魯拉軍團」的 WhatsApp 頻道。該頻道提供每日指示、影片與訊息，協助支持者在網路上分享支持魯拉的內容。根據《衛報》報導，該頻道從首日的 6 萬名追蹤者，在選舉時成長至超過 1,000 萬人。魯拉甚至在勝選演說中稱呼雅諾內斯為他的「將軍」，讚揚他在整個競選期間維持支持者高昂士氣的努力。

paragraphs.en: Lula also changed how he communicated with the public. Despite not owning a mobile phone previously, the president began recording selfie videos to reach voters directly. In his victory speech on Sunday night, he expressed his gratitude to the young people of Brazil for their role in defending democracy. He promised that he would continue to talk directly to the people many times a day using his new phone.
paragraphs.zh: 魯拉也改變了與大眾溝通的方式。儘管先前沒有手機，總統開始錄製自拍影片以直接接觸選民。在週日晚間的勝選演說中，他對巴西年輕人在捍衛民主中所扮演的角色表達了感謝。他承諾未來會利用這支新手機，每天多次直接與民眾對話。

paragraphs.en: Political scientist Camila Rocha, who studies the new right-wing movement in Brazil, suggested that this victory was about more than just one candidate. She noted that the result represents a broad rejection of the political project associated with the Bolsonarista movement. By interviewing undecided voters, she found that many people were deeply concerned about the direction of the country and wanted a change in leadership.
paragraphs.zh: 研究巴西新右翼運動的政治學家卡蜜拉·羅查 (Camila Rocha) 表示，這場勝利的意義不僅止於單一候選人。她指出，此結果代表大眾廣泛拒絕與波索納洛主義運動相關的政治計畫。透過訪談未決定投票意向的選民，她發現許多人對國家發展方向深感憂慮，並渴望領導階層有所改變。

paragraphs.en: As Lula prepares to begin his second term, the focus now shifts to how he will govern a divided nation. The historic nature of this comeback suggests that the combination of grassroots street protests and a highly organized digital strategy has changed how political campaigns are run in Brazil. While the challenges ahead are significant, the president’s ability to turn around his campaign in just three weeks has set a new standard for political comebacks in the region. For now, the country looks toward the future as the new administration prepares to take office.
paragraphs.zh: 隨著魯拉準備展開第二任期，焦點現在轉向他將如何治理一個分裂的國家。這場逆轉勝的歷史意義顯示，基層街頭抗議與高度組織化的數位策略相結合，已經改變了巴西政治競選的運作方式。儘管未來挑戰艱鉅，但總統在短短三週內扭轉選情的能力，已為該地區的政治翻盤樹立了新標準。目前，隨著新政府準備就職，全國正展望未來。

keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「跑」，這裡指競選活動的運作方式。文中：the combination of grassroots street protests and a highly organized digital strategy has changed how political campaigns are run in Brazil.

keyTerms.definitionEn: A set of related proposals or items offered together.
keyTerms.noteZh: 常見作「包裹」，這裡指一系列政策組合。文中：Lula introduced a package of benefits, which included increasing and speeding up payments from the main cash-transfer program designed to help poor families.

keyTerms.definitionEn: To cause something to be successful after it has been unsuccessful.
keyTerms.noteZh: 這裡指扭轉選情，而非字面上的「轉身」。文中：the president’s ability to turn around his campaign in just three weeks has set a new standard for political comebacks in the region.

quiz.question: What was unique about Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva's victory in this election?

options.A: He won by the largest margin in Brazilian democratic history.
options.B: He is the first candidate to win the final vote after finishing second in the first round.
options.C: He secured the presidency despite not being the incumbent candidate.
options.D: He successfully defeated a former president in the final runoff.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據文章第一段，文中明確指出這是巴西民主歷史上首次有在第一輪投票中排名第二的候選人，最終贏得了決選。選項 A 文中並未提及獲勝幅度；選項 C 錯誤，因為 Lula 本身就是現任總統（incumbent）；選項 D 雖然提到對手是參議員 Flávio Bolsonaro，但並未強調這是擊敗「前總統」的創舉，且文中提到 Jair Bolsonaro 是前總統，而非 Flávio。

quiz.question: Based on the text, what can be inferred about the role of Jair Bolsonaro in the election outcome?

options.A: He actively campaigned for his son to ensure a family political dynasty.
options.B: His legal troubles and the associated public reaction negatively impacted his party's momentum.
options.C: He served as a key advisor to Lula during the final weeks of the campaign.
options.D: He was the primary organizer of the digital strategy that helped the left win.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 B。根據第三段，Jair Bolsonaro 因企圖政變而遭居家監禁，這引發了學生抗議，並成為 Lula 支持者反對 Bolsonaro 家族勢力重返執政的動機，進而幫助 Lula 重振選情。選項 A 文中未提及他積極助選；選項 C 與 D 皆與事實相反，Lula 的數位策略是由 André Janones 主導，而非 Jair Bolsonaro。

quiz.question: In the final paragraph, what does the word 'grassroots' mean in the context of 'grassroots street protests'?

options.A: Protests organized by professional political consultants.
options.B: Demonstrations that take place in rural, agricultural areas.
options.C: Political movements initiated by ordinary citizens rather than elite leadership.
options.D: Events that are strictly controlled by the government's official agencies.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 C。「Grassroots」意指「草根」或「基層」，在政治語境中指的是由一般大眾自發發起的運動。文章第三段提到學生自發性走上街頭抗議，這正是草根運動的典型例子。選項 A 錯誤，因為這與專業顧問策劃相對；選項 B 錯誤，草根不等於農村；選項 D 錯誤，因為這類抗議通常是為了反對或施壓政府，而非由政府控制。

quiz.question: What is the primary message of the article regarding Lula's election victory?

options.A: The victory was primarily due to the incumbent president's existing popularity.
options.B: The election was decided entirely by government-funded cash-transfer programs.
options.C: Lula won because he successfully adopted the digital strategies of his opponent.
options.D: The win resulted from a combination of youth-led activism and a highly effective digital campaign.

quiz.explanationZh: 正確答案為 D。文章透過多個段落（第三、四、五段）綜合分析了 Lula 如何從落後轉為獲勝，重點在於學生抗議（街頭能量）、政府福利政策以及極其成功的數位策略（如 WhatsApp 頻道）。選項 A 與文章提到的「第一輪落後」矛盾；選項 B 太過片面，忽略了數位策略與街頭抗議；選項 C 錯誤，文中未提到他模仿對手策略，而是採用了自己的數位動員方式。
